policy.roster: Exact operational 2024–25 CCD LEA 1201500 / FL-50 attachments only; retain the full 238-record directory, 234 operational identities and 230 native profiles. All 170 pure lower configurations match native sources.
policy.populations: Require complete reported pure PK–8 offerings, at least one offered grade 3–8, and explicit zero native Survey 2 enrollment in every grade 9–12. 168 matched profiles are offered-applicable; primary 50-1931 and 50-3100 are nonapplicable. No native zero-high profile has mixed CCD offerings.
policy.native_eligibility: Independent subject eligibility uses same-year raw individual lunch income and native Florida achievement exclusions; 165 eligible schools per subject. Preserve all primary, missing achievement, masked income, high, mixed and missing-Fall records outside eligibility.
policy.source_exclusions: Retain four missing-Fall mixed schools, two primary profiles and three applicable profiles without campus achievement: 50-2791, 50-4100 and 50-0040. The original 58-row CCD membership proof is discovery evidence only, never a fit or native eligibility filter. Provider-specific 50-7001 records with provider IDs 302 and 309 at worksheet rows 2712 and 2713 cannot supply campus outcomes.
policy.zero_income: Preserve all seven verified zero recorded individual lunch eligibility profiles with positive February enrollment. Pure 50-2791 lacks achievement and 50-3100 is primary-only; no eligible school has zero income. Zero recorded eligibility is not evidence that no low-income families attend.
policy.school_types: Retain exact attached-LEA charter, alternative, special-education and Career and Technical flags. Native eligibility retains 141 noncharter and 24 charter schools, comprising 164 Regular schools plus Career and Technical charter 50-3441 South Tech Preparatory Academy. No exclusions based on school-type labels, income extremes or fit diagnostics.
policy.models: Separate 2024–25 native Florida full-year/home-zoned School Grades Math, ELA and Combined ES district OLS; never reuse statewide residuals.
policy.studentization: Externally studentized residuals use deleted-school residual scale with N−3 degrees of freedom.
policy.intervals: Point estimates only: verified native valid-score denominators are unavailable. Counts, sampling variances and all interval endpoints remain null, modelwide. An internal zero variance vector is a computational sentinel, never an uncertainty estimate.
policy.combined: Equally weighted mean of eligible Math and ELA proficiency; not percent proficient in both. No counts or sampling variance are inferred.
policy.release: Numerically verified audit only; source and modeling approval remain false pending independent review and separate canonical/browser integration.

2024-25 Lunch Status Report Methodology
Lunch Status Data Element 146025: https://www.fldoe.org/core/fileparse.php/20744/urlt/2425-146025.pdf

# of CEP Direct Certification with USDA Multiplier
- This value is the total from the school-level report where the CEP Direct Certification USDA multiplier was applied. This count represents the sum of the numbers in the Column “# of CEP Direct Certification with USDA Multiplier” found on the Lunch Status School-Level report.
- When all students in a school are reported under Direct Certification (Codes C & R), the USDA multiplier of 1.6 is applied to the total number of Direct Certification students (C & R).
- If the calculated number exceeds the total school enrollment (membership), it is capped at the membership value.
- Important note: If the school also reports students under the free/reduced-price lunch categories or Provision 2 category, and Direct Certification students are included, the multiplier will not be applied to those students.

# of Free or Reduced-Price Lunch with USDA Multiplier if Applicable (Numerator)
- This number reflects the total count of students reported with specific lunch status codes (D, F, 3, E, 4, R, or C). If the USDA multiplier is applicable to the school, this count will include the Direct Certification students multiplied by 1.6. This count represents the sum of the numbers in the Column “# of Free or Reduced-Price Lunch with USDA Multiplier if Applicable (numerator)” found on the Lunch Status School-Level report.
- If the USDA multiplier is not applied to a school, this number will simply reflect the raw count of students reported under the lunch status codes (without the multiplier).
- If the USDA multiplier is applied, it reflects the adjusted count, which includes the Direct Certification students and their 1.6 multiplier.

Demo Methodology:
-These counts represent the number of students who qualify for Free and Reduced Lunch (FRL). This includes students reported with any of the following Lunch Status codes: 'C', 'R', '3', 'D', 'E', 'F', and '4'.

ELL included after two US-school years; medical/extraordinary exemptions excluded. Components require at least 10 eligible students. Native whole-percent rates only; score denominators absent, so all model sampling intervals unavailable. ELA FAST PM3 grades 3–10 and Math FAST PM3 grades 3–8 plus B.E.S.T./Access Algebra 1/Geometry EOCs; this cohort enrolls no grades 9–12 in the same-year Survey 2 registry. ELL included after two US-school years; medical/extraordinary exemptions excluded. Components require at least 10 eligible students. Native whole-percent rates only; score denominators absent, so all model sampling intervals unavailable. Collocated combined results and provider-specific virtual rates are excluded from individual-school matches.
